description: One OpenAI chat completion auto-instrumented by Laminar, with cache and reasoning tokens.
notes: lmnr 0.8.8. LMNR_PROJECT_API_KEY is capture-project-key. LMNR_TRACE_CONTENT is true, which is also the default, so message content is recorded on the span. LMNR_RELEASE is capture, and initialize also passes release capture, so the git commit is not read. The default export is gRPC with gzip. force_http sends OTLP HTTP to the receiver origin on its port, path /v1/traces. The HTTP exporter hardcodes gzip, which the receiver rejects, so the scenario forces identity compression on the HTTP trace and log exporters before initialize. disable_batch is true. instruments is only OpenAI. ThreadingInstrumentor is always enabled and emitted no spans. There is no separate anonymous-telemetry switch in 0.8.8. One span, openai.chat, type LLM, scope lmnr.tracer with an empty version. service.name is main.py. Token counts are copied from the provider usage: input 24, output 12, cache_read 8, reasoning 3, total 36. gen_ai.request.base_url is the public host https://api.openai.com/v1/. llm.headers is the string None. gen_ai.output.messages is the raw choice object. Span ids in lmnr.span.ids_path are hyphenated UUIDs.
